purpose: Research-only registry for open Islamic NLP, retrieval, knowledge-graph and model-engineering sources that can inform Rechercher Ω. These are engineering inputs and evidence candidates, never canonical religious authority.

sources.name: QURAN-NLP
sources.role: Quran/Hadith NLP, morphology, semantic search, corpus tooling
sources.license: Apache-2.0 code; individual datasets/translations retain their own terms
sources.integration: study semantic search, morphology, canonical-row validation and hadith/isnad graph ideas

sources.name: Adhkar-Duaa Multilingual Database
sources.role: multilingual adhkar/duaa structured data
sources.integration: candidate multilingual schema and ingestion patterns; verify each data item's provenance

sources.name: Arabic NLP GitHub topic/repository family
sources.role: discover Arabic NLP libraries/models
sources.integration: discovery only; promote individual repositories after license and technical review

sources.name: Quranic Arabic Corpus
sources.role: morphology, syntax and linguistic annotation
sources.integration: linguistic evidence/feature engineering; canonical Quran text remains separate

sources.name: Fiqh RAG Engine reference
sources.role: MCP/RAG architecture reference for source-cited fiqh retrieval
sources.integration: architecture study only; do not import its conclusions as religious authority

sources.name: Arabic Embeddings + FlashRank Fiqh RAG benchmark
sources.role: Arabic embedding/reranking evaluation methodology
sources.integration: benchmark design for retrieval/reranking; license and dataset provenance must be reviewed

sources.name: Fiqh-Embed AR/FA
sources.role: Islamic-jurisprudence embedding model candidate
sources.integration: evaluate only as retrieval model; current model targets Ja'fari/Imami jurisprudence and must not silently mix into Sunni evidence lanes

sources.name: MINSA NLP API
sources.role: user-proposed Islamic/Arabic NLP source
sources.integration: candidate architecture/API inspiration only until exact repository, endpoint and license are verified

sources.name: Integrated Islamic Fiqh Ontology & Knowledge Graph
sources.role: user-proposed RDF/OWL/SPARQL ontology
sources.integration: ontology architecture candidate; exact repository and ontology provenance must be verified

sources.name: Islamic Jurisprudence Embeddings Pipeline
sources.role: user-proposed vector/RAG pipeline
sources.integration: RAG/vector architecture candidate; evaluate against grounded-evidence gate and benchmarked retrieval

sources.name: Awqaf-LLM / Awqaf-Gemma Weights
sources.role: user-proposed Islamic LLM weights
sources.integration: do not acquire/use until exact official model repository, weights, license, training-data provenance and evaluation are verified

sources.name: Arena AI Coding Agent (GitHub App)
sources.role: external GitHub coding-agent integration
sources.integration: evaluate as an optional agent worker for repository tasks; use branch/PR isolation, least-privilege permissions and human review; never grant direct Corpus-write authority
sources.notes: Third-party GitHub App; exact installation permissions, data handling and terms must be verified before installation.

sources.name: goose
sources.role: open-source general-purpose AI agent with CLI/API and MCP extensions
sources.integration: candidate execution worker for research automation, repo maintenance and MCP-connected Rechercher tools; keep Corpus boundary and approval gates

sources.name: Qwen Code
sources.role: open-source coding agent with MCP, subagents, agent teams, memory and multi-provider support
sources.integration: candidate coding/review worker for Rechercher Ω; useful for MCP orchestration and local/open-model workflows; verify model/provider terms separately

sources.name: OpenHands
sources.role: open-source autonomous software-development agent with CLI/headless/MCP workflows
sources.integration: candidate CI/repository engineering worker; use only in isolated branches/worktrees with tests and review
sources.license: MIT for core; enterprise directory has separate terms

sources.name: OpenHikmah
sources.role: AI-powered Quran knowledge graph and verse relationship exploration
sources.integration: study graph UX, verse-linking, root/thematic relationship modeling and scholarly safeguards; generated relationships remain non-canonical until evidence-validated

sources.name: الجامع — Hadith Knowledge Graph
sources.role: Arabic-first hadith knowledge graph with isnad, narrator, jarh/ta'dil, meaning-group and subject-tree relationships
sources.integration: research candidate for hadith entity graph, isnad visualization, semantic retrieval and citation-aware research tooling; verify corpus provenance and rights before any reuse

sources.name: Integrated Islamic Ontology
sources.role: Arabic-English Islamic ontology integrating Quran/Hadith resources
sources.integration: ontology/semantic-layer research input for entity alignment and RDF/OWL/SPARQL modeling; never treat ontology-derived relations as religious authority

sources.name: Arabic-PDF-OCR
sources.role: Arabic scanned-PDF OCR pipeline using Tesseract with TXT/Markdown/HTML output
sources.integration: small reference implementation for Arabic OCR output/RTL handling; compare against Rechercher's multi-engine OCR and QC pipeline before adoption

sources.name: arabic-document-ocr-ai
sources.role: Arabic document OCR using Surya/Qwen with bilingual document understanding and spatial text reconstruction
sources.integration: benchmark/reference for Arabic document layout, bilingual OCR and positioned text; isolate model/runtime licenses and provenance

design_note.minsa: Added as engineering research candidate, not as trusted religious source.
design_note.ontology: OWL/RDF can model relationships and support SPARQL, but cannot manufacture fiqh conclusions; every derived claim remains tied to source evidence.
design_note.embeddings: Embeddings are retrieval infrastructure, not truth or authority; evidence IDs, provenance, rights and verification status must persist through retrieval.
design_note.llm: LLM weights can assist synthesis only after the evidence gate and never replace source-grounded evidence or scholar review.
design_note.arena: Arena is an optional external coding-agent worker; repository access must remain least-privilege and all changes flow through isolated branches, tests, evidence and review.
design_note.agent_fleet: Multiple agents are capability workers, not authorities. Rechercher Ω remains the orchestrator; no agent may write directly to the canonical Corpus.
design_note.islamic_graphs: Islamic knowledge-graph projects are research inputs only. Preserve source IDs, provenance, rights and uncertainty through graph construction and retrieval.
